items.raw_excerpt: Across seven healthcare institutions visited by CNA, most patients said they had few or no issues, despite signs warning visitors of potentially longer wait times.
items.summary_en: Singapore's public healthcare clusters have recovered from a nine-hour system disruption. Across seven institutions visited by CNA, most patients said they had few or no issues. Signs warned of longer waits, but waiting times stayed close to normal.
items.summary_ko: 싱가포르 공공 의료 기관들이 9시간 동안 이어진 시스템 장애에서 복구됐다. CNA가 방문한 7개 의료 기관의 환자 대부분은 큰 불편이나 불만이 없었다고 답했다. 대기 시간이 길어질 수 있다는 안내 문구가 붙었지만, 실제 대기는 대부분 평소와 비슷했다.
items.title_en: Most patients say it is business as usual after 9-hour healthcare outage
items.title_ko: 9시간 시스템 장애 복구... 환자들 "큰 불편 없었다"
items.title_original: Business as usual for most patients as public healthcare clusters recover from 9-hour disruption

items.raw_excerpt: The Algarve Wine Society members and guests enjoyed a deliciously prepared dinner and wine pairing at Wyndham Residences Restaurant in Alvor on Wednesday, September 16th.
items.summary_en: Members of the Algarve Wine Society enjoyed a dinner with wine pairings at Wyndham Residences Restaurant in Alvor. The meal took place on Wednesday, September 16th.
items.summary_ko: 알가르브 와인 소사이어티 회원들이 9월 16일 수요일, 알보르에 있는 윈덤 레지던스 레스토랑에서 와인 페어링이 곁들여진 만찬을 즐겼습니다. 이 행사는 지역 와인 애호가들의 작은 모임으로 진행되었습니다.

items.raw_excerpt: A student was caught wearing AI-powered smart glasses during Yonsei University's mathematics essay entrance exam in Seoul on Oct. 10, a week after a similar case at the University of Seoul.
items.summary_en: A student was caught wearing smart glasses powered by AI at Yonsei University in Seoul on Oct. 10. The glasses can show answers on the lens. The same thing happened at the University of Seoul a week earlier.
items.summary_ko: 10일 서울 연세대 수학 논술 입시에서 AI 안경을 쓴 학생이 적발됐어요. 안경 렌즈에 정답을 띄울 수 있는 것으로 알려졌어요. 같은 사례가 일주일 전 서울대에서도 나왔어요.
items.title_en: AI glasses that show answers appear at South Korean university entrance exams
items.title_ko: 렌즈에 정답 뜬다…연세대 입시에 AI 안경 적발, 서울대서도 재현
items.title_original: AI glasses that can show answers on the lens turn up at South Korean university entrance exams

items.summary_en: Chilean university UNAB offers an online degree program called Advance. The model helps more people attend university by studying from home. It makes higher education easier to reach for working students.

items.raw_excerpt: Prices on Copenhagen's apartment market have fallen for the second month in a row, according to new figures, while the opposite is true in Aarhus.
items.summary_en: Apartment prices in Copenhagen dropped for the second month in a row, according to new figures. In Aarhus, prices moved the other way and reached a new record.
items.summary_ko: 새 통계에 따르면 코펜하겐의 아파트값이 두 달 연속 떨어졌다. 반면 오르후스에서는 가격이 반대로 움직여 신기록을 세웠다.
items.title_en: Apartment prices in Copenhagen keep falling while Aarhus hits a record high
items.title_original: Apartment prices in Copenhagen still falling as prices in Aarhus hit new record

items.raw_excerpt: No Distrito Federal, o céu fica com muitas nuvens, mas sem chuvas e continua vigente o aviso amarelo de perigo potencial para baixa umidade.
items.summary_en: Rain is slowing down across Brazil, but storms continue in the southern region. In the federal district, the sky will be cloudy with no rain, and a yellow low-humidity warning is still in effect.
items.summary_ko: 브라질 전국적으로 비는 줄었지만 남부 지역에는 폭풍이 계속되고 있습니다. 연방구역은 비는 없이 흐린 날씨가 이어지며, 저습도 위험 경보의 노란색 주의보가 여전히 발효 중입니다.
items.title_en: Rain eases across Brazil, but storms stay in the south

items.title_original: Chuvas diminuem no país, mas temporal persiste na Região Sul

items.raw_excerpt: Parents, educators and school specialists are being invited to a free session in Portimão on how to support children and teenagers experiencing fear and anxiety.
items.summary_en: A free session for parents and teachers will be held in Portimão. Experts will share how to support children and teens who feel fear and worry.
items.summary_ko: 포르티망에서 학부모와 교사, 학교 전문가를 위한 무료 강연이 열린다. 전문가들이 두려움과 불안을 겪는 아이들과 청소년을 돕는 방법을 알려준다.

items.raw_excerpt: The Greater Taipei area and eastern Taiwan will see sporadic showers on Wednesday, with rainfall potentially intensifying along the north coast and in Yilan County on Thursday, the Central Weather Administration (CWA) said Tuesday.
items.summary_en: The weather agency says northern Taiwan and the Taipei area will see showers on Wednesday. Rain will get heavier along the north coast and in Yilan County on Thursday, then the weather will settle down.
items.summary_ko: 기상청에 따르면 수요일 타이베이를 포함한 북부 타이완에 소나기가 내릴 전망이다. 목요일에는 북해안과 이란 현 일대에서 비가 더 많이 오겠고, 이후 날씨는 안정될 것으로 보인다.
items.title_en: Northern Taiwan to Get More Rain on Thursday
items.title_ko: 목요일 북부 타이완에 더 많은 비 내려
items.title_original: Northern Taiwan to see heavier rain Thursday before weather stabilizes

items.raw_excerpt: As the days get shorter and the mornings turn misty, you may hear Germans start to talk about this condition, which describes that dip in energy and mood when summer’s brightness fades.
items.summary_en: As days shorten and mornings turn misty, Germans often talk about Herbstblues. This term describes the dip in energy and mood when summer's brightness fades.
items.summary_ko: 날이 짧아지고 아침이 안개로 흐려지면 독일 사람들은 Herbstblues라는 말을 자주 하게 된다. 이 말은 여름의 밝음이 사라질 때 나타나는 기운과 기분의 저하를 뜻한다.
items.title_en: German word of the day: Herbstblues
items.title_original: German word of the day: Herbstblues

items.raw_excerpt: Franklin Roosevelt Primary SGB joins call for principal's removal over teacher absenteeism
items.summary_en: The school governing body at Franklin D Roosevelt Primary in Johannesburg is calling for the principal to be removed due to concerns about teacher absenteeism. The issue is prompting discussions among parents and staff about ways to improve the school.
items.summary_ko: 요하네스버그에 있는 프랭클린 루스벨트 초등학교의 학교 운영 위원회가 교사 결근 문제를 이유로 교장 교체를 요구하고 있다. 이 문제를 두고 학부모와 교직원들 사이에서 학교를 개선하기 위한 논의가 이어지고 있다.
items.title_en: Parents call for principal to step down at Johannesburg school

items.title_original: Calls for principal’s removal at Franklin D Roosevelt Primary, JHB

items.raw_excerpt: The project, which costs more than R74 million, is expected to be completed in August next year
items.summary_en: The Gauteng transport department has restarted work on a new bridge in Atteridgeville. The R74 million project is expected to be completed in August next year.

items.title_original: Gauteng Transport reignites Atteridgeville bridge project

items.raw_excerpt: Área de 120 mil metros quadrados fica entre as ruas Adelino Vessossi, Dionira Moletta Klemtz e Carlos Klemtz e foi inaugurada em 2014, com investimentos da Agência Francesa de Desenvolvimento
items.summary_en: A 120,000-square-meter park in Curitiba's Fazendinha neighborhood helps hold excess rainwater to reduce flooding. It opened in 2014 with support from the French Development Agency.
items.summary_ko: 쿠리치바 파젠지냐 지역의 12만 제곱미터 규모 공원은 빗물을 저장해 홍수를 줄이는 데 도움을 줍니다. 이 공원은 2014년 프랑스 개발청의 지원으로 개장했습니다.
items.title_original: Respiro e refúgio verde, Parque Guairacá funciona como área de contenção de cheias no Fazendinha - Prefeitura de Curitiba
